purpose: Teach: 組曲/のぞき/刺客/転居/つぐ/導か/病理/全土

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、バッハの組曲、つまり管弦楽組曲の音楽研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered Bach's suites in your paper — a musical study of the orchestral suites, wasn't it.
lines.style: Measured teacher's cadence, warm and unhurried, a gentle confirming lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、犯罪心理学ののぞき、つまりのぞき行為の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered peeping — a criminal psychology study of voyeuristic behavior — in my paper.
lines.style: Quick eager reply, sitting up straighter, working hard to sound more formal than usual.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史上の刺客の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And a sociological study of assassins through history — you took that on as well, didn't you.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace, an approving nod audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、住民の転居傾向の社会学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered a sociological study of residents' relocation patterns in my paper.
lines.style: Prompt and diligent, a small flush of pride creeping onto the topic name.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 相続でつぐ、つまり継ぐ家業の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered succession — family businesses inherited and carried on — in your paper, yes?
lines.style: Gently probing, deliberate weight on the key word, a patient pause left after it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、結論に導かれる証明手法の論理学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered a logic study of proof methods that lead you to a conclusion.
lines.style: Careful and precise, slowing over the technical phrase like reciting from memory.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 病理、つまり病理組織学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And pathology — a histopathology study — you handled that in your paper too, didn't you.
lines.style: Quiet appreciative wonder under the composure, pace easing as the list nears its end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、全土を網羅する国勢調査の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered a study of the national census — the one spanning the whole country.
lines.style: Bright finishing note, relieved exhale, like ticking off the last item on a list.
